Use a Maneuver to carry or support an adjacent willing or unconscious ally and move up to your Speed without provoking.

Rules

Action
Main Action
Attribute
None (no roll)
Target / range / shape
Self and up to two adjacent willing or unconscious creatures in water whom you can physically support.
Type
Skill / Movement / Utility

With a free hand for each companion, move yourself and up to two adjacent willing or unconscious creatures up to your Speed through water. You support and guide their movement; each ends in a free square adjacent to you. This movement does not provoke. Swimming costs 1 movement per square for this move.
